about: Far-cheek outlines for testing the tracer and the apex and submalar search: synthetic masks and the committed renders, with the Python library's outline and observed points for each, and the frontal constructions of two faces. Written by scripts/make_cheek_outlines.py; don't edit by hand.

mask.synthetic: alpha and gray are rows of [value, count, ...] runs over the image's width; the foreground is alpha > mask_alpha
mask.render: every pixel of the file whose color is not background is foreground, with an alpha of 255 there and 0 elsewhere

outline: x is the traced outline's float32 x in each of rows, src each row's source: 0 contour, 1 mask, 2 nose, 3 intensity edge
observed: every field of cheek_outline.ObliqueCheek; null is NaN
